[P2] Return to design and document the simpler alternatives

**Rule 2, “Simplify before you add,” item 5** requires the description to identify simpler options considered and explain why they do not work when adding logic. This change adds telemetry-3 configuration and selection logic plus shared overloads, but the description only lists the implementation and its testability rationale. It does not provide the required alternatives, leaving the added structure without that design justification. Please return to the design phase under **rule 8, step 6**, document the alternatives and chosen minimal approach, and obtain agreement before revising the implementation.
